target: compose exact compact boundary signatures without enumerating all 2^w assignments

switchboard.dispatch_rule: A signature is authoritative only when its compact representation is supplied with a polynomially checkable family certificate. The switchboard never reconstructs an arbitrary truth table to guess a family.
switchboard.composition_rule: Conjoin compatible exact signatures symbolically inside their family-specific polynomial algorithms; if no certified compact family applies, return OPEN_SIGNATURE_OUTSIDE_SWITCHBOARD.
switchboard.cost_rule: All admitted recognition, verification, composition and terminal decision work must be polynomial in the serialized compact signatures and original input size.
forbidden: enumerating all 2^w boundary assignments to discover the signature
post-hoc family selection using SAT ground truth

theorem_scope: For already-certified compact signatures in the admitted families, exact boundary interaction can be represented and composed without universal assignment-table enumeration.
why_this_matters_for_P_equals_NP: R44B requires U1-U6. R44K advances U2/U3/U4 for a larger representation portfolio, but P=NP additionally requires a deterministic polynomial compiler/discoverer that maps every arbitrary 3-CNF interaction into one admitted compact signature or an exact successor route.
